edition: 0.5.0 read-only reference catalog; not host tool registration

fields.description: Optional comma-separated list of specific fields to retrieve (e.g., 'companyname, email, phone')

recordId.description: The internal ID of the record to retrieve

actionId.description: Optional action ID used to return metadata for a specific action.

recordId.description: Optional internal ID used to return only actions currently eligible for that record instance.

recordType.description: The NetSuite record type to inspect (for example, 'salesorder' or 'timebill').
Optional NetSuite record type to get metadata for (e.g., 'customer', 'item', 'salesorder'), if not provided, metadatas are returned for all record types available for the tool

Optional NetSuite record type to get metadata for (e.g., 'customer', 'item', 'salesorder', 'entity', 'transaction'), if not provided, metadatas are returned for all record types available for the tool

query.description: Optional query to filter the resutls

filter.description: Optional string to filter the available prompts.

accountingContext.description:
Accounting context ID to filter report results.

OPTIONAL: Only include this parameter if the report's supports_accounting_context property (from ns_listAllReports) is true AND ns_getAccountingContexts returns non-empty results. In this case, the value MUST match an ID from ns_getAccountingContexts. Always call ns_getAccountingContexts first to get valid context IDs.

DO NOT INCLUDE this parameter if supports_accounting_context is false or ns_getAccountingContexts returns empty results.

book.description:
Accounting book ID to filter report results.

OPTIONAL: Only include this parameter if the report's supports_book property (from ns_listAllReports) is true AND ns_getAccountingBooks returns non-empty results. The value MUST match an ID from ns_getAccountingBooks. Always call ns_getAccountingBooks first to get valid book IDs.

DO NOT INCLUDE this parameter if supports_book is false or ns_getAccountingBooks returns empty results.

book2.description:
Second accounting book ID to filter report results.

REQUIRED if the report's supports_book2 property (from ns_listAllReports) is true AND ns_getAccountingBooks returns non-empty results. The value MUST match an ID from ns_getAccountingBooks. Always call ns_getAccountingBooks first to get valid book IDs.

DO NOT INCLUDE this parameter if supports_book2 is false or ns_getAccountingBooks returns empty results.

dateFrom.description:
Start date for the report. Must be in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), showing only the date, never including the time.

REQUIRED when: The report's as_of_format property (from ns_listAllReports) is false
OPTIONAL when: The report's as_of_format property is true

Always check ns_listAllReports output before deciding whether to include this parameter.

dateTo.description: End date for the report. Must be in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), showing only the date, never including the time. Always required for all reports.

nexusId.description:
Nexus ID to filter results by tax jurisdiction.

REQUIRED when BOTH conditions are met:
1. The report's supports_nexus property (from ns_listAllReports) is true, AND
2. The taxCashBasisMode parameter is set to NEXUS, AND
3. ns_getNexusIds returns non-empty results.

When these conditions are met, you MUST include this parameter and its value MUST match an ID from ns_getNexusIds, or the tool will fail with an error. Always call ns_getNexusIds first to get valid nexus IDs.

DO NOT INCLUDE this parameter if supports_nexus is false, taxCashBasisMode is not NEXUS, or ns_getNexusIds returns empty results.

periodEndTransactionReportMode.description:
Boolean flag to enable period end transaction report mode.

OPTIONAL: Only include this parameter if the report's supports_period_end_mode property (from ns_listAllReports) is true. Use true to enable period end transaction report mode, or false to disable it.

DO NOT INCLUDE this parameter if supports_period_end_mode is false.

range.description:
Column grouping for report columns.

OPTIONAL: Only include this parameter if the report's supports_range property (from ns_listAllReports) is true.

DO NOT INCLUDE this parameter if supports_range is false.

reportId.description: Numeric ID of the report. Execute ns_listAllReports tool to obtain all available reports and their IDs.

subsidiaryId.description:
Subsidiary ID to filter results.

REQUIRED when BOTH conditions are met:
1. The report's has_subsidiary_filter property (from ns_listAllReports) is true, AND
2. The account has subsidiaries (ns_getSubsidiaries returns non-empty results)

When these conditions are met, you MUST include this parameter and its value MUST match an ID from ns_getSubsidiaries, or the tool will fail with an error. Always call ns_getSubsidiaries first to get valid subsidiary IDs.

OPTIONAL when: has_subsidiary_filter is false OR ns_getSubsidiaries returns empty results.

taxCashBasisMode.description:
Tax cash basis mode for the report.

OPTIONAL: Only include this parameter if the report's supports_cash_basis_mode property (from ns_listAllReports) is true.

Possible values: T (enable cash basis), F (enable accrual basis), or NEXUS (follow preferences for the selected nexus ID).

Specify NEXUS only when the report's supports_nexus property is also true; in that case, nexusId must also be provided. Specifying NEXUS for reports that do not support nexus IDs, or omitting the required nexusId parameter when NEXUS is used, will cause errors.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this query does (e.g., 'Get all customers - page 3 of 8').

pageIndex.description: Zero-based page index. Set to 0 for the first page, then increment through numberOfPages-1 to retrieve all records. Must be used together with pageSize. Always check totalResults and numberOfPages in the first response to determine how many additional pages to fetch.

pageSize.description: Number of records per page. Required whenever querying high-volume record types (customer, item, transaction, salesorder, etc.). Recommended value: 1000. Must be used together with pageIndex.

sqlQuery.description: SuiteQL query string, only SuiteQL syntax is allowed

type.description: This parameter is required if the saved search to load uses a standalone search type. A standalone search type is a search type that does not have a corresponding record type. Typically, the search type of the saved search can be determined automatically based on the corresponding record type. In this case, this parameter is not required.
